# Heroic Warrior (`features:champion-heroic-warrior`)
**Class:** [Fighter](../classes/fighter.md) | **Subclass:** [Champion](../subclasses/champion.md) | **Level:** [Fighter 10](../levels/fighter-10.md)

The thrill of battle drives you toward victory. During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.
